Components/Navigation

Bottom nav

The bottom navigation of a phone app (Material's navigation bar, the iOS tab bar): three to five destinations with an icon, a label and a badge, the current one marked by a pill. Links or a value; an action button in the middle; hides on scroll.

Patterns (tap the destinations; scroll the last one)
Code

Open the code

API

<ray-bottom-nav>

With href items it marks the link to this page (aria-current="page"); without, it is a control (value, change). Clear of the home indicator (safe-area inset). In a ray-app-shell, put it in the bottom slot.

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
valuevalue reflectsstringThe current destination (an item's value, else its href, else its label).
labellabelstringMainAccessible name of the navigation.
labelslabels reflectsalways | active | neveralwaysWhich labels show (the others stay for assistive technology).
indicatorindicator reflectspill | line | nonepillHow the current destination is marked besides its color.
colorcolor reflectsstringA palette color or any CSS color for the current item and the action (default: primary).
variantvariant reflectsdefault | floatingdefaultdefault: a bar across the bottom; floating: a rounded bar off the edges.
hideOnScrollhide-on-scroll reflectsbooleanSlides away while the content scrolls down, back on the way up.
fixedfixed reflectsbooleanPinned to the bottom of the window (outside a shell).
scrollTargetscroll-targetstringA selector of the element whose scrolling it follows (default: its shell's, else the window).
EventDescription
changeThe user picked another destination (read value).
ray-selectAn action item was pressed.
SlotDescription
(default)ray-bottom-nav-item elements (3 to 5).
PartDescription
navThe <nav>.

<ray-bottom-nav-item>

A link with href, else a button. The badge is read with the label ("Messages, 3").

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
valuevalue reflectsstringIts value (default: its href, else its label).
labellabelstringThe label.
iconiconstringAn icon of the registry (or put one in the icon slot).
hrefhref reflectsstringMakes it a link.
badgebadgestringA count or a short text on the icon.
dotdot reflectsbooleanA dot on the icon (something new).
activeactive reflectsbooleanSet by the bar: the current destination.
disableddisabled reflectsbooleanNot interactive.
actionaction reflectsbooleanA raised round button ("New"): it fires ray-select on the bar, it is not a destination.
SlotDescription
iconA custom icon (a ray-icon, an svg, an avatar).
PartDescription
itemThe link or button.
indicatorThe pill behind the icon.
badgeThe badge.
labelThe label.
